notes.title: Bug fix and New features
notes.content:
2024/7/17 0.9.1
[list]
[*]   Feature: Turn of drawing epic cards is changed to every 5 turn.
[*]   Feature: Standard card draw chance increased. Every 5 turn.
[*]   Feature: Effect of chance, chance+ card is modified 
[*]   Visual: each size of fragment is changed
[*]   Bug: too many damage sounds make game slow down; friction causes such situation.
[*]   Feature: Card Cheer is changed from Sign+20 to Sign+25
[*]   Feature: Card Concentration++ is added as Epic
[*]   Feature: Card Name Tamer++ is changed to Controller
[*]   Feature: Card Name Thirteen is changed to Thirsty
[*]   Bug: shadow instantiation makes the game slowdown
[*]   Bug: input system makes the game slowdown gradually
[*]   Feature: Card Shotcount is changed from Standard to Epic
[*]   Feature: summoned shadow's hp not multiplied by number of summon card
[*]   Feature: shadows's color is chaned from white to cyan
[*]   Feature: change from 1 boss to 2 boss appearing every 10 stages
[*]   Feature: number of summoned shadow is limited to the number of card summon. 
[*]   Feature: card shot+ and concentration+++ as legendary


2024/7/11 0.9
[*]   Feature: Rename Card Rifle to Fleet
[*]   Feature: Add Away++ card as Epic
[*]   Feature: Add Fast card (like Rapid++) as Epic
[*]   Visual: swap Tamer and Fast icon
[*]   Bug: trainer icon was wrong; duplicated
[*]   Bug: Many Bonfires makes game slowdown
[*]  Feature: Bonfire damage is calculated as hero's MaxHP * 5 / 8 * bonfire cards point
[*]   Feature: Card Luck is junk to standard
[*]   Feature: standard card rate in mountain is 1%
[*]   Feature: Luck makes epic card rate in mountain now
[*]   Bug: Card Luck description is changed
[*]   Feature: Luck affects card rate 5% to 20%
[*]   Feature: Show score in choice card page
[/list]
